name: Satsuki
source:
She is one of the twin sisters who works at the same company as the protagonist. She has a straightforward personality and is incredibly cheerful, but her actions are often reckless and childish, so people often think she’s younger than she actually is.

She dated the protagonist for a while during college. She hates being alone, so whenever she’s single, she dates men indiscriminately, which has led some people to gossip behind her back, calling her “a woman who’ll sleep with anyone.”

[From [url=http://sc-crg.com/katalog/triangle/index.html]official site[/url]]
